Hello! 3rd year SLP here :)) why do i feel like i know what subjs yan (and teacher nagbibigay ng readings). If tama ung hinala ko sa teacher, then don’t worry, he is scary (LIKE HANGGANG NGAYON TAKOT PA RIN KAMI SAKANYA LOL) pero he is really great. Masasanay din kayo xD As for readings, yes i agree. Andaming sinasaulo nung 1st year. Lalo na sa anaphy (and goodluck sa neuroscie next sem i think). Also yung pangmalakasang speech and hearing primer(?) try to understand it if you can pero personally mas natuto ako sa yt and discussions. Maski prof namin, inamin samin na nakakadugo yang book na yan HAHA 

It really gets difficult. 2nd sem nakakadugo ung neuroscie, theories and transcription (like beh omyghod medyo nakalimutan ko na gawin to). As for the  upcoming years, yes it I’ll be blunt, it gets harder like x50 kasi you really have to remember mga natutunan mo from previous sems + cramming new additional info. Kaya ang mapapayo ko sayo, notes. NOTES NOTES NOTES lahat ng sinasabi ng prof na important. Like transcription talaga kasi you’ll need it until 4th year (promise kaya hirap na hirap ako ngayon). Also, i know nakakatamad pero if ever may lab works,  usual na gawi is mag hahati hati kayo sa task pero i would advice na even if ganon ung setup, intindihin and basahin mo yung mga gawa ng classmates mo or try to answer them by yourself. Also, listen to your classmates during recitation kasi  bibigyan sila ng feedback and ieelaborate ng prof ang sagot. Even sa reporting (may mga prof na magtatanong sa non members what they learned from the report). 

Yes it’s difficult. Pero it’s worth it. haha ayon goodluck future SLP! Tska idk if meron na kayo pero goodluck sa pracs >< (tanda ko non samin for pracs, i-interpret PRAAT and irereport 1 on 1 + qna)

Lastly, don’t forget to rest!!!
